not.name: Not
not.tip: Set to the opposite value of the operand

and.name: And
and.tip: Set to 'True' when both the target variable and the operand are 'True', otherwise set to 'False'

or.name: Or
or.tip: When at least one of the target variable and the operand is 'True', set to 'True', otherwise set to 'False'

xor.name: Xor
xor.tip: Set to 'True' when the target variable is not the same as the operand, otherwise set to 'False'

setBoolean-operand-type.label: Type
setBoolean-operand-type.tip: Select the method to get the boolean value

list.name: List Item
list.tip: Read the list from the variable, and then read the value from the list at the specified position

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.tip: Parameters entered in the 'Show Text' or 'Show Choices' command

setBoolean-list-index.label: Index
setBoolean-list-index.tip: Read the value from the Nth (0, 1, 2, ...) position in the list

setBoolean-parameter-key.label: Param Name
setBoolean-parameter-key.tip: Get the value of this parameter

setBoolean-script.label: Script
setBoolean-script.tip: Execute JavaScript and get the return value
